title: Verify QQ16 paired recovery preserves scalar saving at common precision
body:
[PR #4106](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4106) changes the query arithmetic DAG to save 100 unit ADDs /800 logical scalar allowance against [PR #4015](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4015). This independent audit proves that **the saving survives in a common sufficient finite format**: for every lambda>=1, t=lambda-1, both complete frozen words admit q=h2^(-9-3t) and W=P+28+6t signed component bits, provided all borrowed entry components are in hZ with magnitude<2^P h. This is a sufficient uniform format, not a minimum-width or actual recursive-supplier claim.

The new D+=E intermediate doubles one local envelope 230 to 460, but remains inside the agreeing completed-query bound 11864. Whole-word component/lattice induction includes quarter halvings, all Gaussian interiors, dirty initialization and the deferred tenth host. A separately implemented positive-polynomial certificate F(u)=445+28230u+96u^2+142272u^3, u=2^(lambda-1), dominates [PR #3932](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3932) candidate/[PR #4032](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4032) baseline observations for every u>=1. Both have maximum 171043<2^18 and identical224 endpoint envelopes.

**Rounding and cost results.**

- The specified exact pair-first numerical reference incurs zero arithmetic rounding/overflow at the common q/W.
- A literal source/response/suffix binding plus integer associativity establishes relative fixed-point bit identity under exact nonoverflowing unit additions and common deterministic, bank-independent, isolated callbacks. Approximate native interiors, absolute accuracy and scratch restoration remain separate contracts.
- A new correlated-error interpreter gives equal224 endpoint polynomials and equal conservative logical-cut enclosures. No error independence is assumed. The logical-cut error headroom is 91101 B2^(3t), B=2^P h; actual error-versus-width and native-interior guarantees remain unknown.
- Floating reassociation is not automatic: the actual query scalar subsequences with supplied normalized components v76=4,v87=v92=1 give Q0=4 versus 6 at binary precision2, ties-to-even. This is a query-cut countermodel, not a full rounded-caller reachability claim.
- A declared fixed-bank numerical reference costs (12352+2240lambda)N versus (12152+2240lambda)N, N=2^(73lambda) complex coordinates per owner. It pays shifts, Gaussian interiors, zero stores, signs and both permutation copy legs. The difference is **200N real additions**, a different unit from 800 logical allowance. Common width preserves both comparisons. The proof states an explicit tariff/extra-width break-even inequality.

The inherited [PR #3303](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3303) producer format can be algebraically substituted to give conditional joint q=h2^(-80-22t), W=P+242+44t. This does not establish a selected producer/caller connection or pay conversions. The coordinate Gaussian reference is not a free replacement for a charged recursive H1 implementation. Physical addressing/movement/placement, actual recursive workspace, usage and supplier caps remain open. **No kappa improvement or physical supplier admission is claimed.** Selected conditional kappa remains 0.001672660197076918.

**Scope, pins and overlap.** Assigned changed scope of joint-query-controller, scope key5423eef254a4943f6bf1. Canonical basebb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f, priority 6. Frozen [PR #4106](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4106) head48529915d50bb59b53db53686c4add1cf53429dd and [PR #4015](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4015) head0fff81d8997cef646538bcd4f60d7d455cf93b8e. Five canonical semantic/proof inputs and five retained word/construction/proof files are SHA/Git-blob authenticated before new analysis; no predecessor executable is imported. Endpoint/frame identity is inherited rather than re-executed. Main and predecessor heads remained unchanged at the submission checkpoint. Local overlap helper lacks gh/remote PR and Discussion data; bounded live all-state QQ16 precision/range/rounding searches and current Discussion/canonical reads supplement partial coverage. Concurrent [PR #4108](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4108) addresses a distinct actual caller/query native-acquisition obstruction and is not an executable dependency here.

**Validation.** CPython 3.12.3 registered isolated replay PASS; four boundary groups PASS, including normal/optimized Git-free read-only content equality, source-first authentication, manifest/vendor corruption, type-sensitive whole receipts, duplicate-key rejection and overwrite refusal. Elementary Gaussian1250 cases,104 source basis plus 2 mixed query regressions, independent all-depth certificate and semantic controls pass. Source-before-analysis, changed shared sum/captured recipe, missing native/tenth restoration and illegal private/native overlap reject. Assisted adversarial review found no blocker within the declared scope. Finite checks supplement the written all-depth induction; no human/formal approval or selected cold replay is claimed.

Publication head **30dcf52a7722d0919e125f77a4fb921094578242**. Official committed-byte/source-history and export/check PASS for 33 package/input files; whitespace PASS. The committed Git-free/PATH-free read-only replay also passes with all 34 exported files including the manifest unchanged. Hosted registered verification **passed** in [run 39354072941](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39354072941), [replay job 118405325093](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39354072941/job/118405325093). Completed logs bind synthetic merge a99b40e032e92debfe6b0b05c6e6362c550d7461 to head30dcf52a7722d0919e125f77a4fb921094578242 and basebb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f, CPython 3.12.15. Primary audit, four boundary groups (18.077 seconds), registered completed result and committed-input preservation all PASS. Planning passed 270 tests (11 platform skips) and selected only this package. No scientific bytes changed; hosted reproduction is not supplier/human/formal admission.

```
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-paired-precision
```

PROOF.md, range/rounding/cost notes, complete typed receipts, REVIEWS and TASK document assumptions and evidence. **Next useful experiment:** pin one actual recursive H1 child and its caller entry grid/range; obtain nu(W,lambda), native-interior range, scratch return and full tariff/layout. Test the stated logical margin, all interiors and width-tariff break-even threshold. Stop at the first missing or failing contract; another decoder precision constant does not fill it.
